newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Demand strong at Portugal's Telecel sale.
newsitem.headline: Demand strong at Portugal's Telecel sale.

text.p: Demand in the flotation of a 35.6 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel is stronger than expected, sources close to the operation said on Thursday.
"Demand is pretty strong, especially from institutions," the source told Reuters. "Overall it is above expectations."
Telecel is offering some 7.6 million shares on the market at between 6,900 and 8,100 escudos per share.
The offer, which is expected to be concluded in Lisbon by December 10, would value Telecel at between 148 and 174 billion escudos.
The source said it was still too early to say what the exact price would be.
Bookbuilding began on November 20 and will continue until December 6.
